question: In the passage, the phrase “cultural context” mainly refers to:
solution: The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. Social values influencing interpretation**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **“cultural context”** in the passage refers to the background of social values, traditions, and beliefs that influence how people interpret and understand communication. (सांस्कृतिक संदर्भ का अर्थ है सामाजिक मूल्य जो व्याख्या को प्रभावित करते हैं।) • Communication is not just about words, but also about how those words are received and understood in light of the culture they occur in. • The passage suggests that understanding cultural context is essential for effective communication and avoiding misunderstandings. Therefore, the correct answer is- Social values influencing interpretation [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Universal language rules** (सार्वभौमिक भाषा नियम): The passage does not mention language rules as cultural context. • **Fixed global norms** (स्थिर वैश्विक मानदंड): Culture is dynamic and varies, not fixed globally. • **Grammar structures** (व्याकरणिक संरचनाएँ): Grammar is not the main focus of cultural context in the passage. 42:Ta28, The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. Critical understanding of media messages**.
